headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.initialization_inverseSupport_nonempty
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ) (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
    (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
      2 ≤ m →
        2 ≤ n →
          0 <
              Fintype.card
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
            Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.InverseSupportLabels r c U X)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceDefect_nonempty
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ),
  ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j →
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference →
      Nonempty
        (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys) 7)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceInitializedRetry_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j)
  (hb : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference)
  (h k R : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceInitializedRetryLaw xs ys htotal hb h k R)
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
    (1 - Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCorrectionSuccess xs ys) ^ R +
      ↑R * (Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h + Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic k)
